messages:
Tara Nguyen: Quick heads up — handbook v2.6 just landed with clarifications to the Flexible Office + Data Handling sections. We pushed a short mandatory refresher for all full-time staff in the LMS. Please confirm manager-led completions by EOD next Friday. Link: https://redwood-internal/docs/handbook/v2.6 :calendar:
Kevin Patel: Are contractors required to take the refresher? Some of our hiring cohorts are 1099s. :thinking_face:
Tara Nguyen: Good question — contractors are exempt unless they have payroll access or handle PII. Added a carveout paragraph to the handbook and the LMS cohort tagging. See section "Scope & Exceptions" in the doc. :white_check_mark:
Samir Lee: Legal flagged we need explicit attestation for the Data Handling annex for anyone with access to customer logs. @Jill (Legal) can you confirm the attestation wording?
Jill (Legal): Confirmed — wording is in the PRD I linked in the doc. Attestation text: "I acknowledge I understand the Data Handling annex and will follow its requirements." We recommend a checkbox + timestamp on the LMS completion record.
Tara Nguyen: Thanks Jill — I'll add the checkbox. Also creating a manager nudge template for team leads to run weekly until completion hits 90%.
Maria Gonzales: Can you add EMEA timezones to the calendar invites? We had low turnout last time b/c sessions were PST-only.
Tara Nguyen: Yep — scheduling three regional drop-in hours (EMEA/APAC/US). Will post in #general once scheduled.
lms-bot: LMS cohort update: "handbook-v2.6-refresher" — 48 completions / 317 assigned (15%). Next automated reminder scheduled in 48h.
Kevin Patel: Cool. Any way to slice by product team? I need my eng folks' completion list.
Samir Lee: You can run the peopleops query: `po reports completion --cohort handbook-v2.6-refresher --tag team:eng --format csv`
Tara Nguyen: I'll also share a filtered report to managers: eng / platform / infra this afternoon.
peopleops-bot: Manager digest queued: 1719805600 — will DM managers who are below 75% completion with the template.
Kevin Patel: Template please.
Tara Nguyen: Manager nudge (copy/paste): `Heads up — please ensure your reports complete the Redwood handbook v2.6 refresher by EOD next Friday. Completion URL: https://lms.redwood/handbook-v2.6. Managers: please confirm by replying here with team % and any blockers.`
Kevin Patel: Thanks — will send.
Maria Gonzales: Quick ask: can the LMS require the attestation checkbox only for users with the "customer_logs" permission? Otherwise we'll frustrate other teams.
Jill (Legal): That makes sense. Recommend conditional attestation rule: if permission in {customer_logs, pii_access} then show checkbox on completion.
Tara Nguyen: Agreed. @Samir can infra apply that conditional rule to the sync job?
Samir Lee: On it — I'll add a rule to the assignment job and test in staging. ETA tomorrow EOD.
Tara Nguyen: Perfect. Once Samir confirms, I'll update the handbook appendix to reference the attestation flow and ship a short FAQ in the doc.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: handbook v2.6 update requires reporting for compliance audit. Export snapshot scheduled: 1719880000.
Kevin Patel: If someone fails to complete, what's escalation?
Tara Nguyen: First escalate to manager after one week overdue. If still incomplete after two weeks, People Ops will reach out for case-by-case follow-up. For access-sensitive roles, we may lock access pending completion (legal-approved).
Kevin Patel: Got it.
Maria Gonzales: FYI — I'll run the EMEA pre-roll call tomorrow 9am UTC. Adding a short deck and FAQ.
Tara Nguyen: Awesome — add the drop-in links to the handbook doc. Thanks team.
Samir Lee: Staging test for conditional attestation succeeded. Patch will deploy in ~2h.
Tara Nguyen: Amazing — thanks Samir. I'll update managers when patch is live. :raised_hands:
